name: Scarlet Basilica
summary: At Tyr's Hand, Scarlet Basilica commands the Scarlet Crusade's eastern forces. Crusader Lord Valdelmar oversees the cathedral, a stronghold against the Scourge in the Eastern Plaguelands.

sections.title: Heart of the Eastern Crusade
sections.body: At Tyr's Hand, Scarlet Basilica rises above the Eastern Plaguelands as the Scarlet Crusade's cathedral and command center. The Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades remains the order's spiritual heart, while the basilica anchors its surviving stronghold in Lordaeron. Elite crusaders guard its walls. Inside, Crusader Lord Valdelmar directs the local defense and drives away outsiders who approach.

faq.answer: Scarlet Basilica is the Scarlet Crusade's grand cathedral at Tyr's Hand in the Eastern Plaguelands. It is the order's eastern seat of religious and military authority.

faq.q: Who leads the forces inside the Basilica?
faq.answer: Crusader Lord Valdelmar commands the forces inside Scarlet Basilica. He is a high-ranking Scarlet Crusade leader who holds Tyr's Hand against the Scourge and other enemies he perceives.

faq.q: How does this compare to the Scarlet Monastery?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades is the Scarlet Crusade's primary spiritual headquarters. Scarlet Basilica is its eastern counterpart, a fortified religious center in the Plaguelands.

faq.q: Are travelers welcome inside the Basilica?
faq.answer: No. The Scarlet Crusade attacks travelers who do not wear its crimson colors, believing them tainted by undeath. Alliance and Horde intruders are attacked on sight.

angles.text: As a paladin, you see holy devotion twisted into merciless fanaticism at Scarlet Basilica. Former knights of the Silver Hand serve there.
As Forsaken, you face one of the zealots' most entrenched outposts. The Scarlet Crusade seeks to eradicate all undead, regardless of free will.
